description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kandumulla and Warapalana, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510805
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extents, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land property rights, ownership registration, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
